assumptions.choice: Read literally: the stop lags the price by a distance equal to the current 8-period EMA value, i.e. stop_level = close - EMA(8), ratcheted so it only moves up (max of previous and new candidate).
assumptions.reason: The spec explicitly says 'lagging by a distance equal to the value of the 8-period EMA', so the trail distance is the EMA value itself, not the price-minus-EMA difference.

assumptions.choice: risk_per_share = EMA(8) at the signal bar (since entry - initial stop = EMA), size = floor(0.02 * broker.getvalue() / EMA); require size >= 1 else no trade.
assumptions.reason: Spec: 'potential loss from the stop-loss does not exceed 2% of total trading capital.' The initial stop distance equals the EMA value, and 'total trading capital' is taken as the broker's current account value.

assumptions.choice: The stop follows the bar close (close - EMA, ratcheted up); it is triggered when the bar low <= stop level, exiting the full remaining position at market.
assumptions.reason: Spec says the stop 'follows the price' and 'will not fall below its previous value' but does not name a specific price; close is used for tracking and low for the intrabar breach test.

assumptions.choice: 'Upon reaching price P' is detected when the bar high >= P; TP1 sells 50% of the current position, TP2 closes the remainder. Exits are market orders (filled next bar open per backtrader).
assumptions.reason: OHLCV daily bars: 'reaching' a level means an intrabar touch (high), and market orders are the canonical default. 50% of a small/odd position can be fractional; backtrader permits fractional sizing.

assumptions.choice: Trailing stop is evaluated before the take-profits on each bar.
assumptions.reason: The spec frames the trailing stop as risk management; protective exits are given precedence where the spec is silent on ordering.

assumptions.choice: One position at a time; after a full exit a new breakout entry may occur. Strategy runs on the daily feed as provided.
assumptions.reason: Canonical single-position default; the feed is already D1, matching the spec's D1 requirement, so no gap.
